# Reanalyze Figure 6A

## Step 1: Read and process the data
```{r}
# load the library
library(tidyverse)

# load and process the data
df <- read_tsv("/Users/cmdb/trip-genomic-context/enhancer-IR/data/processed/trip-distance-bins-filtered-mm10.tsv",
               col_names = c("chrom", 
                             "start",
                             "end",
                             "pool_barcode",
                             "score",
                             "strand",
                             "normalization_counts_1",
                             "normalization_counts_2",
                             "expression_counts_1",
                             "expression_counts_2",
                             "gene_chrom",
                             "gene_start",
                             "gene_end",
                             "gene_id",
                             "gene_score",
                             "gene_strand",
                             "distance",
                             "gene_status",
                             "side",
                             "distance_bin"))
```


## Step2: Identify TRIP pools
```{r}
df <- df %>%
  mutate(pool = sub("_.*", "", pool_barcode))
table(df$pool)
```
## Step 3: Calculate IR expression
```{r}
df <- df %>% 
  mutate(gdna = normalization_counts_1 + normalization_counts_2,
         cdna = expression_counts_1 + expression_counts_2,
         IR_expression = if_else(gdna > 0, cdna / gdna, NA_real_))

summary(df$IR_expression)
```

## Step 4: Calculate median IR expression for each pool and bin
```{r}
pool_summary <- df %>% 
  group_by(pool, gene_status, side, distance_bin) %>% 
  summarise(median_expression = median(IR_expression, na.rm = TRUE),
            median_distance = median(distance), .group = "drop")
head(pool_summary)
```

## Step 5: Calculate mean and SEM across pools
```{r}
figure6A_summary <- pool_summary %>% 
  group_by(gene_status, side, distance_bin) %>% 
  summarise(mean_expression = mean(median_expression),
            sem = sd(median_expression) / sqrt(n()),
            mean_distance = mean(median_distance),
            n_pools = n(),
            .group = "drop")
```
## Step 6: Assign negative distance to End side
```{r}

gene_width <- 100 # create a space for the gene for visualization

figure6A_summary <- figure6A_summary %>% 
  mutate(distance_kb = if_else(side == "Start", -mean_distance / 1000 - gene_width / 2, mean_distance / 1000 + gene_width / 2))
```

## Step 7: Plot figure 6A
```{r}
# Count IRs in each gene expression group
gene_counts <- df %>%
  group_by(gene_status) %>%
  summarise(n = n_distinct(pool_barcode), .groups = "drop")

print(gene_counts)

# Prepare labels
n_expressed <- gene_counts$n[gene_counts$gene_status == "expressed"]
n_nonexpressed <- gene_counts$n[gene_counts$gene_status == "non-expressed"]

# Plot
p <- figure6A_summary %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = distance_kb,
             y = mean_expression,
             color = gene_status,
             group = interaction(gene_status, side))) +
  # Gene region
  annotate("rect",
           xmin = -50, xmax = 50,
           ymin = 0, ymax = Inf,
           fill = "grey90") +
  # Lines
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 1) +
  # errorbars
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_expression - sem,
                    ymax = mean_expression + sem),
                width = 2) +
  # Number of IRs in each group
  annotate("text",
           x = -230, y = 1.15,
           label = paste0("n=", n_expressed),
           color = "#F8766D",
           hjust = 0,
           size = 4.5) +
  annotate("text",
           x = -230, y = 1.05,
           label = paste0("n=", n_nonexpressed),
           color = "#00BFC4",
           hjust = 0,
           size = 4.5) +
  #Gene label 
  annotate("text",
           x = 0, y = 0.08,
           label = "Gene",
           size = 4.5) +
  # Arrow indicating gene direction
  annotate("segment",
           x = -45, xend = 45,
           y = 0.16, yend = 0.16,
           arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.45, "cm")), linewidth = 0.6) +
  # Axes
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(-250, -150, -50, 50, 150, 250),
                     labels = c('-200', "-100", "Start", "End", "100", "200")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,NA),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-280, 280)) +
  # Legend
  scale_color_manual(name = NULL,
                     values = c("expressed" = "#F8766D",
                                "non-expressed" = "#00BFC4"),
                     labels = c("expressed" = "Expressed genes",
                                "non-expressed" = "Non-expressed genes")) +
  # Title
  labs(x = "Distance from nearest gene (kb)",
       y = "IR expression (cDNA/gDNA)",
       color = "Gene expression") +
  theme_classic()
p
```

# Step 8: Save the result
```{r}
# save the summary table
write_tsv(figure6A_summary, "/Users/cmdb/trip-genomic-context/enhancer-IR/results/figure6A_summary.tsv")

# Save the plot
ggsave("/Users/cmdb/trip-genomic-context/enhancer-IR/results/figure6A_280kb.png",
       plot = p,
       width = 8,
       height = 5)
```
